notes.title: 1.22.0 Bug fix release
notes.notes: This update is a minor release. It contains several bug fixes. For further details, see the complete release notes.

notes.title: 1.18 Release
notes.notes: See full release notes here.  Lots of improvements for primitives workflow and export:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-18-release-notes.html

notes.title: 1.15 Release: Primitives
notes.notes: We've added non-destructive primitives!  Right click to bring up the action menu and select "add primitive" to get started.  See the rest of the release notes here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-15-release-notes.html

notes.title: 1.11 Release
notes.notes: We have added a scene outliner so that you can view and edit your scene hierarchy as a list.   See release notes for other additions and changes:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes.html

notes.title: 1.10 release
notes.notes:
- Surface tool improvements​
- Save tool settings between sessions​
- VDB Density Field Import (as clay) and Export​
- A lot of UX Improvements

See full release notes here:  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes/v1-10-release-notes.html

notes.title: 1.8 Release
notes.notes: See current release notes for 1.8 features and fixes.  A lot of sculpting tool improvements and camera features.  Release notes will be updated to 1.8 by March 18.  https://helpx.adobe.com/substance-3d-modeler/release-notes.html

notes.title: 1.5 Release
